nom: DRMTLGY HPR Firming and Smoothing Eye Cream

segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive or reactive eyes report the retinoid formula does not sting, burn, or irritate, unlike prior eye creams, and one combination-plus-sensitive reviewer calls it gentle with light, fading fragrance.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s-70s report visible softening of fine lines, crow's feet, and crepey texture with continued use, several calling it the best eye cream tried after decades of products.
segments.combination: The one reviewer identifying combination skin finds the cream light, non-oily, and gentle, still evaluating results after two weeks.
segments.dry: A reviewer coming from a drying previous eye cream reports the HPR cream improved under-eye dryness and bag appearance within a week, though one dissenting reviewer says it dried the skin around her eyes and worsened wrinkles.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report softer fine lines, reduced crow's feet, and firmer-looking skin, some within one to two weeks and others building over months to years; one reviewer explicitly says her wrinkles worsened after 15 days.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers report the eye area feels hydrated, hours after application in one case, and one reviewer said dryness improved versus a previous product, while another reported the product dried the skin around her eyes.
concerns.redness: No reviewer specifically reports on redness.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer specifically reports on barrier repair; several instead note absence of stinging, burning, or irritation from the retinoid.
concerns.spots: No reviewer specifically reports on spots or discoloration beyond dark circles, which are covered under blemishes.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report visible fading of dark circles, under-eye bags, and puffiness, with several noting improvement within one to a few weeks; one reviewer reports reduced milia around the eyelids and another says milia formation stopped.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers note the cream is not oily or greasy despite being moisturizing; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: No pilling under makeup or concealer
No sting or burn from retinoid
Small amount needed, goes a long way
Worth repurchasing, good value over time
Gold trim packaging flakes onto fingers

extraits.texte: I seriously dont get the hype anout this eye cream! bought this after seeing ads promoting it and reading reviews. I used this product for 15 days and It has dried my skin around my eyes and made my wrinkles worse! I returned this to the store.

extraits.titre: "DRMTLGY HPR Eye Cream: My Under-Eye Game-Changer!"
extraits.texte: I've been using the DRMTLGY HPR Firming Retinoid Eye Cream for just a couple of weeks, and it's already a staple in my routine! The lightweight, non-greasy texture glides on smoothly and absorbs quickly without any pilling under makeup or concealer—perfect for my busy mornings. So far, all results have been fantastic: my under-eye area feels hydrated and firmer, with no sensitivities or irritation on my sensitive skin. I'm thrilled with the early brightening on dark circles and can't wait for more wrinkle-smoothing magic. A gentle powerhouse—love it!

So far with combination skin and with sensitivity, this eye cream is gentle. Fragrance is light and fades which I love! It's not heavy or oily. Just enough to moisturize my entire eye area. I have only been using it for 2 weeks now and I like to give any product from 1-3 months to see how well the product is and effective. Starting off, moisturizing is great, for dark circles and wrinkles, only time will tell.

I never have good luck with eye creams/serums because I have extremely sensitive eyes and every product I've tried in the past ends up burning or irritating my eyes. I love how smooth this goes on, no strong smell, no greasy feeling and no stinging or burning! It's definitely a keeper.

This is the only eye cream I've used over the last 40 years that has made a significant difference in the skin around my eyes. The skin became tighter and the wrinkles less deep and visible. It also keeps milia from forming around my eyes. I will never be without it.

The previous eye cream left my eyes itch & dry. Within just a week of using the HPR eye cream my under eye bags & dryness are already improving! This product is definitely on my reorder list for this old lady
I have been using for about 10 days and love that it is retinol but does not irritate my sensitive skin. I use only at night. I find that I'm waking up less puffy and more rested looking.
